highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.0 upgrades to Skia m150 and adds image filter, color filter, and fast-bounds APIs.
highlights_body: This release also caches the SKSurface canvas wrapper, fixes small-sigma raster blurs, and updates HarfBuzz to 14.2.1. Remaining pre-v4 obsoletes are now compile errors, and .NET Interactive support has been removed.

breaking.title: Remaining pre-v4 obsolete members are now compile errors
breaking.body: SKPaint text and font members and obsolete enum values now produce compile errors. Move text sizing and typeface configuration to SKFont and remove references to the obsolete enum values.

breaking.title: .NET Interactive support removed
breaking.body: The SkiaSharp integration for .NET Interactive and Polyglot Notebooks has been removed. Use the standard SkiaSharp NuGet packages in a supported notebook environment or remain on an earlier release.

bullets.detail: The bundled rendering engine moves to chrome/m150 and includes a subsequent upstream bug-fix sync.
The bundled text-shaping engine picks up the HarfBuzz 14.2.1 maintenance update.
The new method calculates conservative paint bounds so callers can reject invisible draws efficiently.
New factories crop image filter output or create an empty image filter for filter-graph composition.
The new color filter maps overdraw counts to colors for diagnosing rendering hotspots.
Small blur radii once again use the correct raster pipeline path instead of producing regressed output.
Repeated Canvas access now reuses the managed wrapper, avoiding recurring allocations in rendering loops.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Small-sigma raster blur correction, SKSurface canvas-wrapper caching, and v4 obsolete API cleanup

v4.150.0-preview.1.1.subtitle: Introduces the Skia milestone 150 engine.

v4.150.0-preview.2.1.subtitle: Completes v4 API cleanup and refreshes text shaping.
v4.150.0-preview.2.1.website_summary: Preview 2 promoted the remaining pre-v4 obsoletes to compile errors, removed .NET Interactive support, and updated HarfBuzz.

bullets.text: Promoted remaining pre-v4 obsolete members to compile errors
Removed .NET Interactive and Polyglot Notebooks support
Updated the bundled HarfBuzz library to 14.2.1

v4.150.0-rc.1.1.subtitle: Adds new filter APIs and rendering improvements.
v4.150.0-rc.1.1.website_summary: Release Candidate 1 added fast paint bounds, crop, empty and overdraw filters, cached SKSurface canvas wrappers, and corrected small-sigma raster blurs.

bullets.text: Cached the SKSurface Canvas wrapper across calls
Applied an upstream chrome/m150 engine maintenance round

harfbuzz_summary: Updates the bundled HarfBuzz library to 14.2.1; the HarfBuzzSharp binding has no API changes in this release.
